existingClaims.reason: The SKF BR930260 hub card lacks drivetrain, ABS, position, trim, and year scope. The current catalog pass did not confirm complete coverage, so its eBay link cannot be treated as universally fitted.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Diagnose by road-testing for speed-related growl, then check each front hub for roughness and play with the wheel off the ground. Replacement typically involves pressing a new bearing into the steering knuckle or replacing the hub/bearing assembly where applicable, followed by alignment verification. Using quality bearings and confirming proper axle nut torque is important to avoid repeat failure.

existingClaims.reason: Denso 221-3702 is role-consistent with the radiator repair, but the card has no enforceable transmission or cooling-package scope and the catalog did not reconfirm the full 2001-2006 2.0L application.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Pressure-test the cooling system and inspect the radiator side tanks, upper neck, and seam crimps for seepage or white residue. Replace the radiator if cracking is found, then refill with the correct coolant mixture and bleed air from the system. Hoses and the thermostat should be inspected at the same time because overheating can damage them as well.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Verify timing belt age and mileage history immediately on any newly purchased Elantra from this era. If the belt has failed, perform a compression or leak-down test to check for bent valves before simply installing a new belt. Preventive service should include the timing belt, tensioner, idlers, and commonly the water pump and accessory belts at the same time.
